reviewPolicy: Count every controlled refusal on an answerable public question as incorrect.
Judge semantic correctness against the cited source text and rendered-source findings when the frozen public reference conflicts with the source.
Treat an answer as incorrect when its requested result happens to match but its supporting factual decomposition is materially false.
Mark citation support false when cited text names the returned value but does not support the relation, period, entity, row, or referenced work asked by the question.
